mapper.sql: bbs20_floral_request_id AS floral_request_id , bbs20_company_id AS company_id , bbs20_reg_date AS reg_date , bbs20_person_id AS person_id , f_emp_kor_nm(bbs20_person_id) AS person_name , ( f_emp_kor_nm(bbs20_person_id)||' ('|| f_get_emptrans(bbs20_person_id, bbs20_reg_date::date, 'org_code_nm')||')' ) AS person_info , bbs20_occasions_cd AS occasions_code , f_cdnm('OccasionsCode', bbs20_occasions_cd, bbs20_company_id, bbs20_reg_date) AS occasions_name , bbs20_message AS message , bbs20_send_company AS send_company , bbs20_send_emp AS send_emp , bbs20_send_pos AS send_pos , bbs20_rcv_company AS rcv_company , bbs20_rcv_emp AS rcv_emp , bbs20_rcv_pos AS rcv_pos , bbs20_rcv_dept AS rcv_dept , bbs20_rcv_tel AS rcv_tel , bbs20_rcv_addr AS rcv_addr , bbs20_send_request_date AS send_request_date , bbs20_send_request_time AS send_request_time , bbs20_status_cd AS status_code , f_cdnm('ApplicationStatusCode', bbs20_status_cd, bbs20_company_id, bbs20_reg_date) AS status_name , bbs20_end_date AS end_date , bbs20_note AS note , bbs20_reason AS reason , bbs20_add_info AS add_info , bbs20_requests AS requests , bbs20_reject_reason AS reject_reason , bbs20_private_yn AS private_yn , ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys10_file WHERE sys10_parent_id = bbs20_floral_request_id ) AS file_count , ( SELECT ( SELECT CASE WHEN bbs21_share_cd = '1' THEN f_emp_kor_nm(bbs21_person_id) ELSE f_org_nm(bbs21_org_id, COALESCE(bbs20_reg_date, f_today())) END FROM bbs21_floral_request_share WHERE bbs21_floral_request_id = bbs20_floral_request_id ORDER BY bbs21_share_cd DESC LIMIT 1 ) || ( CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '||COUNT(*)-1 END ) FROM bbs21_floral_request_share WHERE bbs21_floral_request_id = bbs20_floral_request_id ) AS share_info
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM bbs20_floral_request WHERE bbs20_company_id = #{companyId} AND bbs20_reg_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{closeDate} AND UPPER(CONCAT(f_emp_kor_nm(bbs20_person_id), bbs20_rcv_company, bbs20_rcv_emp)) LIKE UPPER(#{searchText})
AND COALESCE(bbs20_status_cd, '10') NOT IN ('91','92')
ORDER BY bbs20_reg_date DESC, bbs20_occasions_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs22_floral_message ( bbs22_floral_message_id, bbs22_occasions_cd, bbs22_company_id ) SELECT f_create_seq() , a.sys09_code , #{companyId} FROM sys09_code a LEFT JOIN bbs22_floral_message b ON a.sys09_code = b.bbs22_occasions_cd AND b.bbs22_company_id = #{companyId} WHERE sys09_company_id = 0 AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn, 'false') = 'false' AND sys09_code_kind_id = ( SELECT sys08_code_kind_id FROM sys08_code_kind WHERE sys08_kind_cd = #{kindCode} ) AND b.bbs22_occasions_cd IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM bbs22_floral_message WHERE bbs22_company_id = #{companyId} AND bbs22_occasions_cd NOT IN ( SELECT sys09_code FROM sys09_code WHERE sys09_company_id = 0 AND COALESCE(sys09_close_yn, 'false') = 'false' AND sys09_code_kind_id = ( SELECT sys08_code_kind_id FROM sys08_code_kind WHERE sys08_kind_cd = #{kindCode} ) )
mapper.select: SELECT bbs22_floral_message_id AS floral_message_id , bbs22_occasions_cd AS occasions_code , f_cdnm('OccasionsCode', bbs22_occasions_cd, bbs22_company_id, f_sysdate()) AS occasions_name , bbs22_message AS message FROM bbs22_floral_message WHERE bbs22_company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY bbs22_occasions_cd

SELECT bbs21_floral_request_share_id AS floral_request_share_id , bbs21_floral_request_id AS floral_request_id , bbs21_share_cd AS share_code , share_nm AS share_name , bbs21_person_id AS person_id , person_nm AS person_name , bbs21_org_id AS org_id , org_nm AS org_name FROM ( SELECT bbs21_floral_request_share.* , f_cdnm('ShareCode', bbs21_share_cd, 0, f_today()) AS share_nm , f_emp_kor_nm(bbs21_person_id) AS person_nm , f_org_nm(bbs21_org_id, COALESCE(bbs20_reg_date, f_today())) AS org_nm FROM bbs21_floral_request_share LEFT OUTER JOIN bbs20_floral_request ON bbs21_floral_request_id = bbs20_floral_request_id WHERE bbs21_floral_request_id = #{floralRequestId} AND bbs20_company_id = #{companyId} ) t ORDER BY bbs21_share_cd DESC , org_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8" , person_nm COLLATE "ko_KR.utf8"

SELECT ( SELECT CASE WHEN bbs21_share_cd = '1' THEN f_emp_kor_nm(bbs21_person_id) ELSE f_org_nm(bbs21_org_id, COALESCE(bbs20_reg_date, f_today())) END FROM bbs21_floral_request_share LEFT OUTER JOIN bbs20_floral_request ON bbs21_floral_request_id = bbs20_floral_request_id WHERE bbs21_floral_request_id = #{floralRequestId} ORDER BY bbs21_share_cd DESC LIMIT 1 ) || ( CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 1 THEN '' ELSE ' 외 '||COUNT(*)-1 END ) FROM bbs21_floral_request_share WHERE bbs21_floral_request_id = #{floralRequestId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bbs21_floral_request_share ( bbs21_floral_request_share_id, bbs21_floral_request_id, bbs21_share_cd, bbs21_person_id, bbs21_org_id ) VALUES ( #{shareId}, #{floralRequestId}, #{shareCode}, #{personId}, #{orgId} )
